channel.desc: When a snowstorm blows into Bristol, Gav surprises Ricky by announcing that Christmas is here! He tries to resist everyone?s enthusiasm to celebrate the big day early, but after creating a turkey game, a festive flowery wreath and paper baubles ? and with a flat full of sprouts, even Ricky falls under the Christmas spell. Then, along with his little helpers, Ricky uses ninja and Christmas magic to make epic ?snow? art which even Santa would be proud of.
